endpoint.authorization: Bearer token verified by Auth; active database session grant

query.after: resolved-play sequence acknowledged by client; default 0

response.generatedAt: persisted source commit UTC timestamp; never request wall time
response.throughEventSequence: zero-based raw history index including scoring records; -1 before history
response.plays.sequence: one-based resolved-play sequence; differs from raw eventSequence
response.nextSequence: last acknowledged resolved-play sequence for next page
response.hasMore: true while snapshot has further plays
response.fieldAvailability: per-field BLOCKED reasons; missing authoritative records never fabricated
response.teamStatistics: away then home; exact 27 keys each
response.field: offense-relative live coordinates or explicit OT BLOCKED status

recovery.sameRevision: continue with run/version and acknowledged nextSequence
recovery.newRevisionSameRun: discard old summary, request after=0 and rebuild pages at returned revision
recovery.changedRun: clear displayed pages, request after=0; retain old immutable server journal
recovery.lag: BLOCKED SOURCE_REVISION_UNAVAILABLE until projection reaches independently read authoritative version
recovery.writer: replay every committed revision in order from explicit genesis version 0; exact retry permitted; gaps/rewrite rejected

blockedPayload: envelope only: no scoreboard, statistics, field, possessions or plays
wp: No model, prior, sampler, observation journal or UI change. WP thread consumes separately authorized committed state; this detail endpoint is not a sampler trigger.
